snippet.title: One Must Rule - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the shoes of a Ruler in One Must Rule, a strategic roguelike auto-battler and engine builder. Transform a humble settlement into an unstoppable kingdom, draft deep synergies between your buildings and units, and test your tactics in automated battles against both PvE and PvP builds.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424940/One_Must_Rule/
